run_cot_decoding: run CoT decoding on a math word question using sglang with top-k logprob analysis
fork_sgl_state: fork an sglang state into multiple parallel decoding paths for top-k token selection
generate_top_k_logprobs: generate top-k logprobs for the next token with max_tokens=0 to peek at candidate tokens
calculate_probability_disparity: calculate probability disparity between top and secondary tokens for confidence scoring
extract_answer_span: extract a generated answer span from sglang with logprob-backed token-level confidence
